The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

To establish a reliable payment system, consider deploying the Sovereign Starter Stack. This stack combines GitHub Pages for hosting your digital products, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency payments. With USDT on Tron settling almost instantly and for less than $0.10 per transaction, you can ensure that transactions are swift and cost-effective. This infrastructure gives you complete control over your sales and data, eliminating reliance on third-party platforms. You can have your store operational within 48 hours.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on the essentials to get your store live quickly. Skip complex integrations that are not necessary at the start. For instance, while advanced marketing tools or elaborate customer management systems may be beneficial later, your immediate priority should be setting up a simple store that can process payments. Keep it straightforward: a clean product page, an efficient payment processor, and reliable file delivery via Google Drive is enough to get started. Avoid distractions that could delay your launch and concentrate on executing the core components.

Getting Your First Transaction Live

Once your digital store is set up, it’s time to test your payment system by making your first sale. Promote your store on social media or among your network to generate initial interest. This first sale is critical in validating your setup and building momentum for future sales.
